title: Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend | May 2026
excerpt: May is one of the most beautiful months to experience the NC High Country, with wildflowers blooming, trails opening up, and the region buzzing with local events. Whether you're visiting for the weekend or quietly wondering what it would be like to call this place home, Andrew Plyler has your insider guide.
